seo.title: Your Company — forged grills and cauldron stoves in Tashkent
seo.description: A forge in Sergeli making 4–6 mm steel grills, cauldron stoves, fireplaces and turnkey barbecue areas. Hand forging, heat-proof paint and a 3-year warranty.
seo.answer: Your Company is a forge in Sergeli: hand-forged grills from 2,800,000 UZS, 12–22 litre cauldron stoves from 3,500,000 UZS, forged fireplaces from 9,000,000 UZS and turnkey barbecue areas from 24,000,000 UZS. 4–6 mm steel, heat-proof paint to 800 °C, 3-year warranty. Phone +998 71 200-04-03.

listing.description: A website for a forge or grill workshop: live fire on the first screen, a priced product catalogue, the master and crew, and a gallery of work.

sections.title: Fire loves thick steel
sections.subtitle: We forge grills, cauldron stoves and fireplaces from 4–6 mm steel. Metal this thick does not warp in the heat and outlasts the dacha it stands in.

sections.label: The forge
sections.title: Every piece goes through the forge
sections.text: We started with grills for neighbours in the mahalla and now make forty pieces a month. Legs, handles and grates are hand-forged on the anvil and the body is welded with a continuous seam, so smoke stays in and the coals hold their heat to the last skewer.

sections.label: Catalogue
sections.title: What we forge
sections.intro: Prices are for standard sizes. We adapt any piece to your yard, cauldron or alcove.

items.title: 10-skewer grill
items.text: 4 mm steel, forged legs, a log shelf and a rain cover.

items.title: Cauldron stove

items.title: Grill with a roof
items.text: A metal-sheet roof, worktop and hooks for tools.

items.title: Forged fireplace
items.text: A 6 mm steel firebox with a forged screen and log store.

items.title: Turnkey barbecue area
items.text: Grill, cauldron stove, sink and worktop in a single unit.

sections.label: The smith
sections.title: Forged by people who grill themselves

items.title: Measurement
items.text: A craftsman visits with samples, takes measurements and talks through the job. Free within Tashkent.

items.title: Sketch
items.text: We draw a sketch and price the job. We revise it until you like it, at no extra charge.

items.title: Fabrication
items.text: We cut, bend, forge and weld in our own workshop, sending photos at every stage.

items.title: Finishing
items.text: Metal primer plus powder or forge paint, so the finish does not peel after one season.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We deliver and install in a day, clean up after ourselves and sign the warranty.

items.quote: The 22 litre cauldron stove is in its third year: the paint holds and the door has not warped.
items.author: Shukhrat

items.quote: They built a barbecue area with a sink to fit our yard and delivered and set it up in a day.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.q: Why 4–6 mm steel and not 2 mm?
items.a: Thin metal burns through in two or three seasons and warps in the heat. Thick steel keeps its shape and heat, so coals burn more evenly.
Yes. Bring the cauldron or give us its diameter and we will make the ring to fit it exactly.

items.q: How long does the paint last?
items.a: Heat-proof paint withstands up to 800 °C. After 3–4 years a spray can refresh it; we sell one with each piece.

items.q: Do you deliver outside the city?
items.a: Delivery in Tashkent is free, outside the city on quote. We carry in and install heavy stoves ourselves.
